newsitem.title: INDIA: India Century down 4.6 pct on results.
newsitem.headline: India Century down 4.6 pct on results.

text.p: Shares of India's Century Textiles & Industries skid 111.0 rupees or 4.6 percent, to 2,290.0 at the Bombay exchange on Tuesday after the firm announced a 99 percent fall in 1996/97 (April-March) net profit, traders said.
The company blamed adverse market conditions in cement and paper and teething troubles at its Bagasse-based plant among the major factors for the steep fall in net profit.
At 1350 hours, (0720 GMT) the stock was down 136.0 rupees, or 5.7 percent, at 2,265.0, with over 42,000 shares traded.
At the National Stock Exchange, Century shares were trading 120.50 rupees, or five percent, lower at 2,279.50 with 14,050 shares changing hands.
Century said it would offer investors one bonus equity share for every one share held. It maintained dividend at 60 percent.
The company's results and the bonus issue were finalised at a board meeting on Tuesday.
